name: Clojure shell/sh invoking a shell with concatenated string
attack_scenario: pattern = "x file.txt; rm -rf ~" executes the injected command inside bash -c.
negative_test_hint: pass pattern = "x file.txt; rm -rf ~" and assert no shell interprets it, so grep runs without the injected rm command executing

exemplar.explanation: clojure.java.shell/sh with separate string args is safe (no shell), but passing "-c" plus a (str ...)-built command routes user data through a shell where metacharacters are interpreted.
